description: GOA AQUA WORLD Looking for the perfect family outing or a fun-filled day in Goa beyond the beaches? Welcome to Goa Aqua World, an exciting and vibrant water park in Goa located in the lush surroundings of Sanquelim. Designed for kids, thrill-seekers, and families alike, Goa Aqua World Water Park is fast becoming one of the most sought-after attractions in North Goa. With multiple water rides, adventure activities, and lush green surroundings, this aqua paradise delivers an unforgettable blend of relaxation and excitement. GOA AQUA WORLD LOCATION Goa Aqua World is a large-scale water adventure destination offering a variety of attractions for all age groups. Unlike typical amusement parks, it’s designed as a refreshing day-long experience combining water rides, recreational areas, adventure games, and even interactive experiences like rain dance and water zorbing. Located in Sanquelim, this attraction is ideal for tourists exploring North Goa’s hinterlands or locals seeking a short getaway. Whether you’re on a family holiday, a school picnic, or a corporate trip, Goa Aqua World Sanquelim has something for everyone. GOA AQUA WORLD WATER PARK – WHAT TO EXPECT The Goa Aqua World Water Park experience includes: - Wave pools and lazy rivers - Rain dance zones with upbeat music - Giant water slides and spiral tube rides - Kiddie splash zones and family-friendly pools - Water zorbing, bumper boats, and aqua cycling - Adventure park elements like ziplining and wall climbing GOA AQUA WORLD RIDES Goa Aqua World Rides are designed to deliver adrenaline-pumping excitement and gentle fun alike. Some popular attractions include: - Twister Slide - Family Slide - Float River - Wave Pool - Multi-lane Racers - Rain Dance Platform - Kiddie Pools with Mushroom Showers GOA AQUA WORLD SANQUELIM Goa Aqua World Sanquelim is nestled in the quiet and scenic town of Sanquelim, known for its temples, greenery, and tranquil vibes. This location makes it a peaceful yet accessible spot for both locals and tourists. The park’s lush landscaping and hill views create a relaxed, family-friendly setting with minimal urban noise—perfect for a refreshing day out. GOA AQUA WORLD SANQUELIM TICKET PRICE Entry to Goa Aqua World (formerly known as Sharvraj Eco Farm) in Sanquelim starts at ₹299 per person, which typically covers access to the waterpark and amusement activities. Additional options—like adventure packages featuring water rides, zip-lines, roller coaster, and more—are available, usually priced between ₹300 to ₹700 per person, depending on the specific activity bundle. GOA AQUA WORLD REVIEWS Visitors offer a mixed but generally positive view of Goa Aqua World. Many praise the extensive range of over 30 attractions—including water slides, pools, and adventure rides—calling it a “destination packed with fun.” The site’s eco–tourism theme and diverse offerings, from roller coasters to kid-friendly zones, receive high marks. Occasional concerns include maintenance and cleanliness issues in some areas, but overall, families and groups consistently enjoy the variety, natural setting, and thrill-packed experiences. HOW TO REACH GOA AQUA WORLD BY AIR: - Nearest Airport: Goa International Airport (Dabolim) - Distance: Around 45 km - Travel Time: Approx. 1.5 hours via car or taxi BY TRAIN: - Nearest Railway Station: Thivim Railway Station (~25 km away) - Well connected to other parts of Goa and major cities BY ROAD: - You can take Kadamba Transport buses to Sanquelim from Mapusa or Panaji - Taxis and rental scooters are available for tourists staying in North Goa BY CAR: - From Panaji: ~35 km (~1 hour) - From Mapusa: ~25 km (~40 minutes) NEARBY ATTRACTIONS TO GOA AQUA WORLD After a fun day at the water park, explore these nearby attractions to complete your Sanquelim experience: SAPTAKOTESHWAR TEMPLE – 10 MINS AWAY One of the most revered Shiva temples in Goa, Saptakoteshwar Temple blends heritage and serenity. Set amidst a quiet village backdrop, its historic architecture and spiritual ambiance make it perfect for a peaceful cultural detour. HARVALEM WATERFALLS – 20 MINS AWAY Nestled in the Western Ghats, Harvalem Waterfalls gush beautifully during monsoon. Surrounded by lush greenery, it’s an ideal spot for nature photography, picnics, or simply soaking in the refreshing atmosphere of Goa’s hidden gems. SANQUELIM MARKET – 5 MINS AWAY A lively local market, Sanquelim Market offers a vibrant mix of Goan spices, produce, clothing, and souvenirs. Great for picking up authentic local products and interacting with friendly shopkeepers in a traditional bazaar setting. MAYEM LAKE – 30 MINS DRIVE A serene freshwater lake surrounded by rolling hills and forest trails, Mayem Lake is a peaceful retreat. Boating options, birdwatching, and scenic views make it a favorite for families and nature lovers alike.

Where is Goa Aqua World located?

Goa Aqua World is located in Sanquelim, North Goa. It is easily accessible via public transport and private vehicles, and is one of the most visited amusement parks in the area.

Where is Goa Aqua World located?

Goa Aqua World is located in Sanquelim, North Goa. It is easily accessible via public transport and private vehicles, and is one of the most visited amusement parks in the area.

What are Goa Aqua World timings?

Goa Aqua World is open every day from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. It’s advisable to arrive early to enjoy all the rides and activities.

What are the main attractions at Goa Aqua World?

The park features over 30 water and adventure activities, including:

Water slides and splash pools
Roller coaster rides
Zip-line and rope climbing
Kids' play zone
Boating and bumper cars
Is Goa Aqua World suitable for kids?

Yes, the park is very kid-friendly and has a dedicated zone for children with age-appropriate rides, water play areas, and fun games.

Are food and drinks available inside the park?

Yes, Goa Aqua World has an in-house restaurant and snack stalls offering local Goan cuisine, fast food, beverages, and ice creams.

Is parking available at Goa Aqua World?

Yes, there is ample free parking space available for both two-wheelers and four-wheelers near the entrance.

What are the best months to visit Goa Aqua World?

The best time to visit is during the winter and pre-summer months (October to April) when the weather is pleasant and outdoor activities are more enjoyable.
